interfaces.changes: ItemChange native target/type/formula/add; typed bonuses use the highest matching value. Equipment is active while equipped.
interfaces.ac: ac with deflection/luck propagates to touch/flat-footed AC and CMD; never add a duplicate CMD change.
interfaces.naturalArmor: nac/base grants a competing base natural armor bonus; nac/enh improves natural armor separately, as reviewed in race/item data and apply-changes.
interfaces.ability: Core enhancement targets modify current total/undrained, not base. First 24 hours and permanent-only consequences remain explicit manual handling.
interfaces.naturalAttack: nattack/ndamage apply to natural-subtype attacks. Core unarmed Strike has weapon subtype; unarmed coverage is manual under #38 until a reviewed attack-specific interface exists.
interfaces.conditionalNotes: Maneuver, Light and unarmed notes do not add global bonuses; crafted choices remain unselected.
